mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACT WHERE CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACT SET CONTRACT_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId}

#{contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('EFFECTIVE', 'SIGNED') AND END_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND DATEADD('DAY', #{days}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY END_DATE ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_contracts, SUM(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_contracts, SUM(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_contracts, SUM(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING') THEN GUARANTEE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as pending_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 'EFFECTIVE' THEN GUARANTEE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as active_amount FROM TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId}
